series: Words for what you already feel

lines.say: Pro-Israel and pro-peace? Here's how to say it, in 8 words.
Dinner with friends. You mention Israel, and someone asks:
It's not just a slogan. In 1979, Israel made peace with Egypt and gave back the Sinai. In 1994, peace with Jordan.
And in 2022, about 193,000 Palestinians worked in Israel and the settlements, for more than twice the local wage.
Save this one. Pro-Israel. Pro-peace. Not opposites.
Which sentence do you need most? Tell me in the comments.
And it all starts with 8 words.

caption_en:
The dinner question that leaves you quiet. 🍽️

You support Israel, and someone asks: so you're against Palestinians? Here are the 8 words:

"I'm pro-Israel and pro-peace. Those are not opposites."

🇪🇬 1979: Israel signed peace with Egypt and handed back the Sinai (Egypt Israel Peace Treaty, 1979).
🇯🇴 1994: peace with Jordan (Israel Jordan Peace Treaty, 1994).
💼 2022: about 193,000 Palestinians worked in Israel and the settlements, at an average 276 NIS a day, against 125.6 NIS for wage employees in Judea and Samaria (West Bank) (Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics, Labour Force Survey 2022).

Which sentence do you need most? Tell me below.

Part 1 of "Words for what you already feel". Part 2 on my profile.

Sources: Egypt Israel Peace Treaty 1979; Israel Jordan Peace Treaty 1994; PCBS Labour Force Survey 2022.

caption_he:
השאלה מארוחת הערב שמשאירה אתכם בשקט.

אתם תומכים בישראל, ומישהו שואל: אז אתה נגד הפלסטינים? הנה המשפט:
"אני פרו ישראל ופרו שלום. זה לא סותר."

🇪🇬 1979: שלום עם מצרים, וסיני הוחזר.
🇯🇴 1994: שלום עם ירדן.
💼 2022: כ-193 אלף פלסטינים עבדו בישראל ובהתנחלויות, בשכר יומי ממוצע של 276 ש"ח, מול 125.6 ש"ח לשכירים ביהודה ושומרון (הגדה המערבית) (הלמ"ס הפלסטינית, 2022).

איזה משפט הכי חסר לכם? כתבו לי.
